## Why This Is Asked

In fintech-like domains, event-sourced architectures are common and replay safety critical. This question probes experience with end-to-end validation, idempotency, and exactly-once guarantees under stress.

## Key Concepts

- Event sourcing and CQRS
- Idempotent event handlers and deduplication
- Exactly-once processing and out-of-order delivery
- Replay scenarios, rollback, and read-model consistency

## Code Example

```javascript
function applyEvent(state, event) {
  const id = event.aggregateId + ':' + event.sequence
  if (state.seen && state.seen[id]) return state // idempotent guard
  // apply logic depending on event.type
  const next = { ...state, data: {/* updated */}, seen: { ...(state.seen || {}), [id]: true } }
  return next
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you simulate out-of-order delivery and replay in CI?
- What metrics and dashboards would you use to detect drift between write models and read models?
